prompt: A very minimal orthographic top-down town map for a Game Boy style cozy cyberpunk game. Show exactly five buildings: three simple storefront facades along the top edge, one apartment entrance at bottom-left, and one ramen entrance at bottom-right. Use very large flat shapes, blank signboards, plain windows, and simple doors. The center must be mostly empty pavement with only a few puddles and one vending cart. No road texture bricks, no rain streaks, no tiny details, no text, no labels, no numbers. The scene must survive downscaling to a 160x144 four-color handheld screen.
style: minimal handheld JRPG tilemap, bold clean silhouettes, flat grayscale graphic design, no texture
composition: top row of three facades, empty center plaza, bottom-left apartment, bottom-right ramen, lots of negative space
lighting: flat readable grayscale with a soft nighttime mood
palette: black dark gray light gray white only
constraints: strict top-down, flat simple forms, no clutter, no characters, no text, no perspective tilt
negative: letters, logos, textures, bricks, rain streaks, painterly rendering, realistic shading, cluttered map, side view, isometric
